text:
**Leafy Plus costs $59/year** and includes:

- **Free Standard shipping** with no minimum order value
- **Free change-of-mind returns** (normally $6.95)
- **90-day guarantee** on plants (vs. the standard Plant Care Guarantee)
- **10% member pricing** on pots and accessories
- **Early access** to rare plant drops

It auto-renews yearly. You can cancel anytime with a full refund within **14 days** of purchase or renewal, *as long as you haven't used any benefits*—otherwise the membership continues to the end of your paid year.
